subject: Late morning sleep window - acceleration data lost past midday

messages.author: 8456d3d3c4afb88e
messages.subject: Late morning sleep window - acceleration data lost past midday
parts:
Hi all,

I have noticed that when a sleep window begins in the late morning (e.g. 8am) and goes beyond midday, any acceleration data beyond midday is lost. I use Relayonsleeplog=TRUE. I have examples where the log is set at 8am-2pm but the acceleration/algorithm ends at midday. Therefore sleep duration, efficiency etc data is lost.

has anyone experienced this and is there a way to avoid this?

thanks
Aron
